# Mass Air Flow Sensor Performance and Signal Check

**Make**: Toyota
**Model**: Corolla
**Year**: 2014
**Diagnostic Code**: P0171

## Description and Procedure
Unmetered air leaks downstream of MAF sensor cause lean codes P0171 and false airflow calculation. Clean hot wire sensing element.
Vehicle system troubleshooting guidance for P0171 on 2014 Toyota Corolla.
Always adhere to shop safety practices when servicing engine systems.
